params.body:
## Summary
- The profile dropdown (`.ui-user-menu`, opened from "Shane" top-right) relied entirely on the Bootstrap `dropdown-menu-right` class to right-align itself against `.dropdown-menu`'s default `left: 0`. Both classes have equal specificity, so which one wins is a matter of source order between two separately built stylesheets (the purchased theme CSS and `refresh.css`), not something guaranteed by any single file.
- `.ui-user-menu` now sets `right: 0; left: auto;` directly, so the alignment no longer depends on load order between those two stylesheets, plus a `max-width: calc(100vw - 24px)` safety net so it can never run past the viewport edge.
- The `.ui-language-menu` ("NL") already set `right: 0; left: auto;` directly (not via the Bootstrap class) and needed no change.
- The mobile bottom-sheet behaviour for `.u-pro .dropdown-menu.show` under 768px (from a recent PR) is untouched and still verified working.

## Test plan
- [x] `vendor/bin/phpunit --filter='HandlerWiring|AlpineExpression|StylesheetSyntax|CompiledViews|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity'` — 19 tests, 769 assertions, all green.
- [x] Manual screenshot check at 1440px (desktop) and 390px (mobile) confirming the menu stays right-anchored, fully on-screen, and the mobile bottom sheet still opens correctly.
params.title: The profile menu opens inside the screen on desktop
